description: The recorded test set (the Owner's direction of 2026-11-11: detect accidentally removed or skipped tests). A recorded test that was not skipped and does not run, or a skip not recorded here, fails tools/check_test_budget.py check; new tests need no change here. Re-record it (check_test_budget.py record --profile <full profile>) only in a reviewed change that removes, renames or skips tests deliberately.
